references.text: Connects the gift of Zilpah from Laban to Leah's use of her to bear children.
Shows the consequence of the gift in Gen 29:24 through Zilpah's first birth.
Confirms Zilpah's role as a fertility surrogate for Leah.
Summarizes how Laban's gift to Leah resulted in an entire tribe.
Leah interprets the gift of Zilpah as God's reward for her barrenness.
Shows the symmetrical parallel where Rachel uses Bilha in the same way Leah used Zilpah.
Confirms that Zilpah's sons belong to Leah through the gift from Laban.
